socketFrame.ordering: messageId starts at 1 per socket and increments at complete message; sequence starts at 0 per message. End flag iff accumulated bytes equal total. One assembly per socket, 30s deadline. Total storage reserved before accepting first fragment. Credit returned after each fragment is copied into reserved assembly, never waiting for full-message completion. Empty messages carry one END fragment. Closing cancels partial assemblies.

crypto.signature: 64 bytes r||s lowercase hex ECDSA SHA-256
crypto.instanceId: lowercase base32 no padding of SHA256(public key bytes)
crypto.transcript: UTF8(narrafork-remote-v1\0) followed by uint32 big-endian length-prefixed UTF8(label), then length-prefixed UTF8(each field); signaling signature domain is unchanged; DataChannel wire version is v2

hello.ready.backendIdentity: RemoteBackendIdentity; required in narrafork mode, absent in explicit prototype mode

auth.token: opaque NF session; never persisted by Go

ready.backendIdentity: same verified identity as hello.ready; prototype alone uses apiVersion:1,appVersion:prototype-1

request.accept.profile: request|sse; selected only by trusted NF policy

socket.window.bytes: positive fragment bytes copied to reserved assembly

ordering: All channels ordered/reliable. HTTP request.accept precedes request body. Response frames can precede response.open across channels. hasBody:false is implicit EOF. Socket frames and socket lifecycle controls share realtime ordering. No silent drop, automatic write replay, HTTP fallback or TURN.

ipc.ready: identity only; no implicit production invitation
ipc.peer.open: after durable grant, before login; peer.accept supplies contextId/contextCapability and matching backendIdentity

bridge.auth: POST /_nf/remote/session/introspect {token} -> RemoteSessionProjection; read-only; no public /me in production
bridge.headers: bounded real headers, no cookies, proxy/forwarded headers, browser Host/Origin, bridge secrets or redirects
